comments.body:
***Tricholoma sejunctum*** (Sowerby:Fr.) Quél.
Is a medium-size to large species, with a radially fibrillose, greenish to olivaceous cap (margin often whitish or yellow) and whitish gills. This species occour ib deciduous forests. *Tricholoma equestre* has squamulose cap and pale yellow gills; mycorrhizal with Pinus.
